##### Project general facts

Yas Beach Residence is a stunning waterfront development. This glamorous building features an impressive selection of studios, apartments, duplex apartments, and duplex penthouses, each offering panoramic views of calm, blue waters from every level. Through its premium facilities and amenities, this development reaches endless horizons, offering residents a luxurious escape where they can retreat into the rhythm of the sea.

Residents enjoy the sunlight entering through floor-to-ceiling bay windows and wide balconies overlooking the sea, the infinity pool, greenery, and the boulevard. The development captures a sense of exuberance and passion with extraordinary destinations alongside the glistening waters of Yas Island. Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, Yas Beach Residence offers a lifestyle of tranquility just steps away from Yas Island's endless thrills.

Every residence at Yas Beach Residence features optimized interior space with a sense of proportion and scale. Floor-to-ceiling windows ensure rooms are bathed in natural light with unobstructed views of the beach, canal, or glittering streetscapes of Yas Bay, along with generous outdoor spaces. Kitchens are smartly fitted with dedicated spaces for branded appliances, living quarters are designed to host and entertain, and bedrooms are splashed with warm colour materials left untouched for personal design to call it your home.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Yas Island, a vibrant and integrated community that embodies the spirit of entertainment, leisure, and modern living, this exceptional location has transformed into a multifaceted community where residents, tourists, and businesses converge. From luxury residences to hotels, entertainment venues, and commercial spaces, the island offers a comprehensive range of living options that cater to various preferences and needs.

The location is distinguished by its world-class attractions that bring residents and visitors together, including the adrenaline-pumping thrills of Ferrari World, the aquatic adventures of Yas Waterworld, and international sporting events at the Yas Marina Circuit. Diverse dining options, retail outlets, cultural experiences, and a vibrant events calendar with concerts, festivals, and exhibitions create an environment where social interactions thrive.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, excitement, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Yas Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class attractions, thoughtful planning, and a prestigious location makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
